info.name: Booking Pangkas Rambut API
info.description:
API Collection untuk Sistem Booking Antrian Pangkas Rambut.

## Cara Penggunaan:
1. Import environment file terlebih dahulu
2. Jalankan request Login Admin untuk mendapatkan token
3. Token akan otomatis tersimpan di environment variable

## Public Endpoints (No Auth Required):
- Services, Tukang Cukur, Schedules
- Booking (Create, Check Status, Cancel)
- Queue Today

## Admin Endpoints (Auth Required):
- Semua CRUD operations
- Dashboard, Reports, Logs
